# anti-slop-tools

A vendored lint policy kit: the neutral anti-slop Oxlint plugin for
TypeScript, the anti-slop-python policy (ruff families, ast-grep evidence
rules, a `# SAFETY:` filter), two shell installers that vendor both into
consumer repos, and the guidance skills.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): what the repo is, family links and install path.
- [docs/quickstart.md](docs/quickstart.md): the numbered path from nothing to a
  passing policy in a consumer repo.
- [docs/how-to.md](docs/how-to.md): day-to-day tasks: handling findings,
  updating vendored copies, writing a justified `# SAFETY:` line.
- [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md): full command surface, every error string
  and its fix, recovery procedures, and the verification gates.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, verification commands, and how to
  open a change.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the repo's rules for an agent working in it.
- [anti-slop/README.md](anti-slop/README.md): the TypeScript plugin provenance
  and vendoring config.
- [anti-slop-python/README.md](anti-slop-python/README.md): the Python policy,
  its three lanes, and its lineage.
- [anti-slop-python/tests/README.md](anti-slop-python/tests/README.md): the
  fixture exercise for every evidence rule.
- [skills/](skills/): one skill per boundary: `anti-slop`,
  `anti-slop-python`, `authoring-oxlint-anti-slop-rules`,
  `authoring-shadcn-lint-rules`.

## Family

Part of the AI ECP family: independent, single-purpose repos. The policy
control plane (the family docs standard, verification harness, and skill
pack) lives in the private control-plane repo, which is not public.

## Status

Shipped: the TypeScript plugin source, the Python policy, both installers,
the skills, the tests fixture. Design-only: no npm packaging, no PyPI
package, no CLI; this is vendored source, checked 2026-10-22.
